title: a launch from a cwd outside any git checkout fails, naming the folder
source: cli/jitso/root.test.ts: 'outside a git checkout it throws a message that names the folder'
intended: project = git root of the cwd (PLAN.md decision), TS resolves from the script folder
intent: The project is the git primary checkout of the cwd. A cwd outside any git checkout is an environment error: exit 3, one stderr line `jitso: <cwd> is not inside a git checkout` that names the folder, nothing written, orca never called. The TypeScript binary finds its project from its own script folder (REPO = the folder of index.ts), so it ignores the cwd and succeeds. The exit code 3 is the harvester's choice: it is the code index.ts gives to an environment error in `launch`.
